postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (1 <= output[0] <= m and 1 <= output[1] <= m)
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 indicating that it's impossible to make the grid good, or two integers representing the indices of the columns to be swapped.

postconditions.expression: output != -1 ==> all(grid[i][output[0]-1] <= grid[i][output[1]-1] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, then after swapping the specified columns, each row in the grid will be sorted in non-decreasing order.

invariants.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in grid)
invariants.description: Each row in the grid has exactly m elements.

invariants.expression: all(all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in row) for row in grid)
invariants.description: Each element in the grid is a positive integer.
